claims.statement: PyTorch tensors hold structured numeric data; scalars, vectors and matrices are zero-, one- and two-axis forms, and shape records axis lengths.
claims.scope: Dense regular score examples only; axis labels are author-assigned meanings, not inherent Tensor semantics.

evidence.supports: Multidimensional Tensor and construction from lists
Zero-dimensional scalar; one-dimensional vector and two-dimensional matrix vocabulary
Dimension count and per-axis size

claims.statement: torch.tensor builds the 2x3 score table; indexing returns the first row or a selected scalar; shape gives torch.Size([2,3]); tuple(shape) and tolist preserve displayed order; item works only on one element.
claims.scope: Exact fence and documented display/read conversions; conversion operations do not mutate scores. No claim about differentiability or arbitrary serialization.

evidence.supports: Sequence-to-Tensor construction
Integer and tuple-of-integer indexing
One-element item restriction, shape sizes and ordered nested-list conversion
tuple(iterable) keeps item order
Original Size([2,3]), first row and 100.0 outputs
